<thought>We have the TiO₂ slab CIF and need to add a CO₂ molecule 2 Å above the surface. The adsorption site JSON is empty, so we’ll use the default placement. I will provide a valid CO₂ CIF (with proper data block name and atom site loop) to the add_adsorbate_to_slab_text tool, then write the resulting combined structure to a CIF file and return its path.</thought>
<action>add_adsorbate_to_slab_text</action>
